description: Every value has a type (`int`, `float`, `str`, `bool`, `NoneType`) that decides which operations work on it.
A name attached to a value with `=`. The right side is computed first.
`/` always gives a float; `//` gives the whole part of a division; `%` gives the remainder.
Text written as `f"..."` that holds expressions in braces; `{x:.2f}` shows two decimals and `{x!r}` shows the value as code.
`int("42")`, `str(42)` and `float("2.5")` build a value of another type; `int("4.5")` raises ValueError.
